description: IB V, 36a. Money order. In Arabic script with a Hebrew 'emet' at the top. Abū l-Faraj is asked to pay 2.5 dirhams to the bearer Sayyid Muḥammad (or Bū Majd?). Belongs with T-S AS 181.10 (PGPID 37438). Previously thought to be an Abū Zikrī Kohen order of payment, but in fact it looks quite different. (Information in part from Goitein's note card.)
tags: cheque, IB5, money order, India Book, informal note, Arabic script
description_he: הוראת תשלום; בערבית עם 'אמת' עברי בראש; אבו אל-פרג' מתבקש לשלם 2.5 דירהם לנושא הפתק סייד מוחמד
